pit#372, cv/pit#374 (pit 0.36.5).

A tool of a pi-durable extension can now have an optional \`present\` field, so that the code that knows the tool shows its calls, not pi-action. pi-durable is unchanged: pi-action reads the field as \`unknown\` and checks it (\`src/tool-presentation.ts\`).

- \`present.call(args)\` → \`{ title, body? }\`: the \`🔧\` line, and the details in place of the arguments.
- \`present.result(args, result)\` → \`{ summary?
